name: sekura
description: Security scans of your GitHub repositories, with proof for each finding.

interface.longDescription: Sekura scans the GitHub repositories you grant its GitHub App for security vulnerabilities, and reports each finding with the proof that it is real. From here you can see which repositories Sekura can scan, follow a scan as it runs, read a summary of what it found and open the full report, change when a scheduled repository is scanned, and cancel a scan or a schedule. Nothing starts, changes or is cancelled until you have read what will happen and agreed.
